title: ::calendar in notes: the coming days, or a week to drag in, live
steps: Open Week at a glance: the next three days as a list, then the week as in the Calendar. Both keep up as events change: move one in the week, and the list above follows.
In the week, click an empty half hour or drag to make an event, drag one to move it, and press h and l (with the calendar focused) to go back and on.
Hover an embed and choose Settings: change View to 3 days, Month or Agenda, Days, or Height. It redraws in place, at the same dates.
Move the cursor onto an embed's line and off again, or scroll it away and back: it's the same calendar, where you left it.
Agents: list_embeds describes calendar, with its arguments and an example.
